subject: Insurance
title: India's Microinsurance Boom
description: A 60-second lesson on India's Microinsurance Boom.

hook.text: India's government offers life insurance for 436 rupees a year—about $5.

buildup.text: Most Indians couldn't afford traditional life insurance. Microinsurance makes coverage accessible for pennies a day.

discovery.text: The program pays 200,000 rupees ($2,400) on death—enough to cover funeral costs and several months of family expenses.

twist.text: Claims processing in rural India is slow. Families wait months for payouts while grieving and struggling financially.

climax.text: India proved life insurance can scale to hundreds of millions at tiny premiums.

punchline.text: $5 a year for 200 million people. India mass-produced life insurance.

quiz.question: How much does India's government life insurance cost per year?
